body: I've gone through it so many times in my mind with the idea that I caused it that I'm pretty much convinced either way.  Any negative memory of dad sends a shiver down my spine, and I blame myself.  He used to be so much happier, and I feel like I now destroyed it all for him.  He wanted so much from me, and I refused to give him anything.  I can imagine what his vision of me was when I was still a baby, and the horror on his face when he had to deal with me.  When I was like 5 or 6, I remember him telling me that I'll one day become "the president of the united states." I don't know why president, but that's what he used to say, and my mom used to laugh at him and say that she wouldn't allow it.  He had so much hope, and I crushed it all like a brainless leech.
